svg.text: One question: does a candidate add reliable predictive value beyond a matched expression reference?

g.text: Same units · same folds · frozen models
FIT REPRESENTATIONS WITHIN EACH TRAINING FOLD
All adaptive choices stop at the biological-unit boundary
M3 · Fit feature maps and classifiers using training units only
Feature maps and classifiers are fitted within each training fold
map parameters remain fixed at test time
HELD-OUT UNIT ENTERS AFTER ALL FITTING IS FROZEN
Same held-out IDs for both models
Paired scores are computed on identical test units
*Reference weakening: sensitivity only, outside primary criteria.
ALL CRITERIA MET → REPORT POSITIVE EVIDENCE
Held-out observations bypass every fitting operation.
Independent expression/PCA cohorts: GSE47751 and GSE202011.
Source panels [5, 6]; all other miniatures are schematic, not results.
